description: This file exports various functions, constants, and types related to building messages, handling streams, and integrating with Ollama APIs, acting as an API aggregation or interface layer.

methods.name: buildAssistantMessage
methods.description: Builds an assistant message, likely formatting or structuring message data for a chat.

methods.name: buildOllamaChatRequest
methods.description: Constructs a chat request object suitable for Ollama API calls.

methods.name: createConfiguredOllamaCompatStreamWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper with specific configuration for Ollama compatibility.

methods.name: convertToOllamaMessages
methods.description: Converts generic message objects into the specific format required by Ollama.

methods.name: createConfiguredOllamaCompatNumCtxWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper for Ollama compatibility with numerical context configuration.

methods.name: createConfiguredOllamaStreamFn
methods.description: Sets up a stream function configured for Ollama.

methods.name: createOllamaStreamFn
methods.description: Creates a basic Ollama stream function.

methods.name: isOllamaCompatProvider
methods.description: Checks if a given provider is compatible with Ollama.

methods.name: parseNdjsonStream
methods.description: Parses a stream of newline-delimited JSON data.

methods.name: resolveOllamaBaseUrlForRun
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for an Ollama run request.

methods.name: resolveOllamaCompatNumCtxEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether numerical context features are enabled.

methods.name: shouldInjectOllamaCompatNumCtx
methods.description: Decides if numerical context should be injected into the stream.

methods.name: wrapOllamaCompatNumCtx
methods.description: Wraps a function or stream with numerical context compatibility.

methods.name: createOllamaEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Creates an embedding provider for Ollama models.
